answer.reason: The PICKUP keys are lowercase copies of all seven KilnwisePhase values, one for one, and the core looks up the raw vendor phaseCode text by them in PieceService.get. Neither ARCHITECTURE.md nor any glossary names these phases. The domain's own, coarser vocabulary is the map's values (WAITING, IN_THE_KILN, COOLING_DOWN, READY_FOR_PICKUP, FIRING_FAILED), not its keys.
